/let processSpecial {: start=0 end={{lastMessageId}}
    /setvar key=rangeStart {{var::start}} |
    /setvar key=rangeEnd {{var::end}} |
    /setvar key=currentId {{var::start}} |

    /while left=currentId right={{getvar::rangeEnd}} rule=lte guard=on {:
        /messages names=off {{getvar::currentId}}-{{getvar::currentId}} |
        /setvar key=currentMessage {{pipe}} |
        /if left={{getvar::currentMessage}} right="</Freesia_Impersonate>" rule=in
        {:
            /echo Petals: 存档特殊消息, 类型: Freesia Impersonate, Id: {{getvar::currentId}} |
            /hide {{getvar::currentId}}
        :} |
        /if left={{getvar::currentMessage}} right="</Freesia_Summary>" rule=in
        {:
            /echo Petals: 存档特殊消息, 类型: Freesia Summary, Id: {{getvar::currentId}} |
            /hide {{getvar::currentId}}
        :} |
        /addvar key=currentId 1
    :} |
    /flushvar currentMessage |
    /flushvar currentId
:} |

/buttons labels=["存档全部","恢复全部", "存档N条之前", "恢复最近N条", "存档范围", "恢复范围", "存档特殊"] 消息存档菜单 (使消息对 AI 隐藏) |
/setvar key=selected_option |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="存档全部" rule=eq {:
    /hide 0-{{lastMessageId}} |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已存档全部消息
:} |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="恢复全部" rule=eq {:
    /unhide 0-{{lastMessageId}} |
    /:processSpecial |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已恢复全部消息存档
:} |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="存档范围" rule=eq {:
    /input 请输入要存档的消息范围(格式: 起始-结束,例如 1-5): |
    /setvar key=range {{pipe}} |
    /if left={{getvar::range}} right="" rule=eq {:
        /echo severity=warning Petals: 操作已取消 |
        /flushvar range |
        /flushvar selected_option |
        /abort
    :} |
    /hide {{getvar::range}} |
    /flushvar range |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已存档指定范围的消息
:} |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="恢复范围" rule=eq {:
    /input 请输入要恢复存档的消息范围(格式: 起始-结束,例如 1-5): |
    /setvar key=range {{pipe}} |
    /if left={{getvar::range}} right="" rule=eq {:
        /echo severity=warning Petals: 操作已取消 |
        /flushvar range |
        /flushvar selected_option |
        /abort
    :} |
    /unhide {{getvar::range}} |
    /:processSpecial |
    /flushvar range |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已恢复指定范围消息的存档
:} |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="存档特殊" rule=eq {:
    /:processSpecial |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已存档特殊消息
:} |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="存档N条之前" rule=eq {:
    /input 请输入要存档多少条消息之前的消息（默认为 5）: |
    /setvar key=n {{pipe}} |
    /if left={{getvar::n}} right="" rule=eq {:
        /setvar key=n 5
    :} |
    /sub {{lastMessageId}} {{getvar::n}} |
    /hide 0-{{pipe}} |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已存档 {{getvar::n}} 条消息之前的消息 |
    /flushvar n
:} |
/if left={{getvar::selected_option}} right="恢复最近N条" rule=eq {:
    /input 请输入要恢复多少条最近的消息（默认为 5）: |
    /setvar key=n {{pipe}} |
    /if left={{getvar::n}} right="" rule=eq {:
        /setvar key=n 5
    :} |
    /sub {{lastMessageId}} {{getvar::n}} |
    /unhide {{pipe}}-{{lastMessageId}} |
    /:processSpecial |
    /echo severity=success Petals: 已恢复最近 {{getvar::n}} 条消息 |
    /flushvar n
:} |
/flushvar selected_option

/setglobalvar key=Petals_Task_Summary "{{getglobalvar::Petals_Prefix_User}}{{getglobalvar::Petals_Name_Freesia}}, please hold off on continuing the story for now. ## Task Guidelines

1. Structure & Flow
   - Organize events strictly in chronological order, mirroring their original sequence.
   - Highlight causal relationships between events.

2. Content Requirements
   - **Neutrality:** Report only observable actions, decisions, and consequences. Avoid analysis, foreshadowing, or character motivations.
   - **Completeness:** Include all pivotal plot points that alter the story's trajectory.

3. Narrative Voice
   - Adopt an **omniscient third-person perspective** with a focus on objectivity.
   - Use narrative language to summarize, telling it like a story and avoiding lists or other structured formats.

4. Thinking & Validation
   - Before writing the summary, take some time to think and capture your thoughts within the <thinking> tag.

1. First, output the thought process within the <thinking> tags, and then present the summary content within the <Freesia_Summary> tags. Write summary in {{getglobalvar::Petals_Language}}.

   - Integrate the possibility of {{user}}'s participation into the new story arc naturally but don't describe {{user}}'s specific actions, thoughts, or dialogues at this stage.

模型使用说明

1. Claude 官网 Cookie (Clewd)
• 模型/渠道设置为 Claude Cookie

2. Claude 第三方 API/公益站
• 模型/渠道设置为 Claude API
• NoAss 插件 Squash Role 改为 User
• API连接配置中提示词后处理设为严格

• 模型/渠道设置为 Claude API (Prefill)
• 必须安装并启用 NoAss 插件
• NoAss 插件 Squash Role 改为 Assistant

4. Claude You.com
• 模型/渠道设置为 Claude You.com

5. DeepSeek V3
• 模型/渠道设置为 DeepSeek
